Render a CRUK table in Shiny

Source: R/crukTable.R
renderCrukTable.Rd

Server counterpart to crukTableOutput(). expr is evaluated reactively and can return either:

Usage

renderCrukTable(expr, env = parent.frame(), quoted = FALSE)

Arguments

expr

An expression that returns a crukTable(), a data frame or a matrix.

env

The environment in which to evaluate expr.

quoted

Is expr a quoted expression? Mainly useful for other functions that wrap this one.

Value

A render function for use as output$id.

Details

  • a table built with crukTable(), so you can set any of its arguments (and use reactive values in them), or

  • a data frame or matrix, which is passed to crukTable() with its default arguments.

Returning NULL renders nothing.

See also

crukTableOutput(), crukTable()

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  library(shiny)
  library(dplyr)

  ui <- fluidPage(
    crukTheme(),
    selectInput("cyl", "Cylinders", choices = sort(unique(mtcars$cyl))),
    checkboxInput("paginate", "Paginate"),
    crukTableOutput("default_table"),
    crukTableOutput("custom_table")
  )

  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    filtered_data <- reactive(filter(mtcars, cyl == input$cyl))

    # Data only: crukTable() defaults
    output$default_table <- renderCrukTable(filtered_data())

    # Call crukTable() yourself to change its arguments
    output$custom_table <- renderCrukTable({
      filtered_data() |>
        tibble::rownames_to_column("car") |>
        select(car, mpg, cyl, wt, hp) |>
        crukTable(filterable = FALSE, pagination = input$paginate)
    })
  }

  shinyApp(ui, server)
}
